hostSync.semantics: LFO RUN=LOOP preserves HOST/EXT RESET/FREE behavior exactly. LFO RUN=ONE SHOT is note-triggered: note-on resets the existing 921 LFO, one selected waveform cycle is passed, then modulation is muted until the next note-on; HOST/EXT reset events are ignored while ONE SHOT is active so the contour cannot be restarted unexpectedly. The family delay receives host BPM independently and uses it only when its own MODE is SYNC.
